VA.boundary_date: 2026 current reference, not certified election-day shapes
VA.notes: Only 710 supported precincts are mapped, not all Virginia. Each has literal 2026 source IDs/names, valid nonoverlapping current-reference shapes, one nonvirtual House reporting unit and method vectors that exhaust its locality/House summary. Other precincts, missing county early/mail allocations and unreported methods are not repaired. The official current reference was edited September 22, 2026 and captured during reporting, not certified as election-day geometry. All 357 original-response files, all earlier full reports/demographics, unlocated method vectors, original boundaries and all exclusions remain in the complete download. Separate native ballot/registration observations have no inferred rates.
VA.next_action: Resolve withheld literal labels, invalid/null shapes, overlapping boundaries, split-district units and county early/mail allocations using authoritative sources. Never allocate votes or substitute candidate counts for participation.
